themes.label: Vegan cheese selection
themes.text: Reviewers praise the wide, hard-to-find range of vegan cheeses, including in-house ones and samples, though a few cheeses were hit-or-miss.
quotes: The BEST place to buy vegan cheese. So good!! I go here everytime I'm in the neighborhood.
Great selection of not easy to find vegan cheeses!

themes.label: Sandwiches and breakfast
themes.text: Most reviewers love the sandwiches and breakfast items, but one found the mustard overpowering and another found a sandwich puny.
quotes: Incredible vegan sandwiches; the cheese is life changing and the bread is great too
Didn't enjoy the M. Night Salami. Puny, with scant accompaniment to the main ingredient

themes.label: Friendly helpful staff
themes.text: Staff are described as kind, knowledgeable and quick, offering guidance and samples to customers.
quotes: The ladies there are super kind & welcoming.
Great staff. Excellent vegan food.

themes.label: High prices
themes.text: Several reviewers note that cheeses and other items are expensive, though some accept this as the cost of vegan ingredients.
quotes: Everything is expensive, but rendering cheese from nuts is arduous work.
be careful of $15 dairy-free yogurts

themes.label: Small cramped space
themes.text: Reviewers say the shop is tiny with little seating, though many still feel it is worth visiting.
quotes: Not much room to sit, but my new favorite to go spots
Bit cramped but totally worth it.

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Many reviewers praise friendly, attentive staff, while others describe slow, rude or inattentive service, forgotten orders and a decline over time.
quotes: And while there was only one waiter, he still managed to be quick & attentive.
The ticket times here are strenuously long, the staff is rude and I've watched them give my food to the table next to mine.

themes.label: Empanadas and Colombian dishes
themes.text: Empanadas, including Colombian and Philly cheesesteak versions, plus arepas and bandeja paisa, are repeatedly recommended.
quotes: Must try Phillycheese steak empanadas!
I recommend the arepas, curried chickpeas and plantains.

themes.label: Vegan food tastes like meat
themes.text: Reviewers say the vegan food is so flavorful that non-vegans and meat eaters enjoy it and barely notice it is vegan.
quotes: I even forgot that I was eating vegan food.
the V Spot is vegan without the taste of vegan.

themes.label: Flavor and greasiness complaints
themes.text: A few reviewers found some dishes flavorless, greasy or poorly made, such as canned-tasting soup and under-seasoned food.
quotes: It's fried everything for vegans. Even the burrito was greasy.
it tasted like it came from the can

themes.label: Cozy small atmosphere
themes.text: The room is described as quiet, cozy and laid back, though some note it is small with close tables.
quotes: such a comfortable, laid back atmosphere. Loved everything about it.
Small place. Table close together.

themes.label: Creative, flavorful vegan food
themes.text: Reviewers praise inventive, tasty dishes such as arancini, nachos, hen of the woods and seitan chops, often convincing non-vegans.
quotes: every time I've gone I get comments that they wouldn't have known it was vegan if I hadn't told them
You cannot go wrong with the putine but you would be doing yourself a disservice if you do not get the aranchini.

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Many found staff friendly and attentive, but some reported uninterested, slow or rude service, including a one-star complaint about a manager.
quotes: Service was friendly and fast.
The staff didn't care much for their job, and handed us the check just after we had ordered dessert.

themes.label: Atmosphere and decor
themes.text: The room is described as dark, modern, swanky and beautiful, though a few found it loud or somewhat pretentious.
quotes: The atmosphere is very modern and swanky, with comfortable dim lighting.
I really loved the atmosphere of this place, it's dark and chill.

themes.label: Drinks and cocktails
themes.text: Wine, sangria, cocktails and beer selection are repeatedly called great or delicious.
quotes: Great cocktails, with more types of sangria than I've seen in my entire life.

themes.label: Price and portions
themes.text: Most describe large, filling portions and fair value, while a few found it pricey or too expensive.
quotes: Large portions, delicious food and great service.
A little pricey, but it's high quality and vegan.

themes.label: Burgers and sandwiches
themes.text: Reviewers praise the burgers, especially the Sunshine burger, and sandwiches such as the jackfruit and philly, though one found the jackfruit sandwich too sweet.
quotes: I'm not even vegan or vegetarian but the Sunshine burger is incredible.
Wonderfully messy, delicious sandwich. I had the philly

themes.label: Fries and cheese sauce
themes.text: Cheese fries, cashew cheese sauce and house-made ketchup are repeatedly singled out as delicious, though one reviewer found the fries too salty.
quotes: Cheese fries are to die for and you won't feel gross after eating them.
The fries with cashew cheese sauce where great

themes.label: Small cramped space
themes.text: The shop is tiny with few tables and gets crowded, though some find it cozy and suited to takeout.
quotes: Come for takeout, as there are only two or three small tables.
in a tiny but cozy atmosphere

themes.label: Staff and service
themes.text: Many describe friendly staff, but a few reported rude or indifferent counter service and slow orders.
quotes: The lady at the counter could not be less pleased to help us.
Such friendly service!!! The food is to die for!!!

themes.label: Price and portions
themes.text: Some call prices great or decent, while others find it pricey for smaller portions or quality.
quotes: It can be expensive for smaller portion sizes.
Awesome food at awesome prices!

themes.label: Vegan gluten-free crepes
themes.text: Crepes, both sweet and savory such as the burrito and pizza crepes, are widely praised as delicious, creative and filling, though a few find them thick or tasteless.
quotes: Best crepes I ever had. Completely vegan and super affordable.
Amazing crêpes! Light, fresh, filling. Warm hug from the inside.

themes.label: Friendly staff
themes.text: Many reviewers describe the staff as friendly, warm and helpful, though a few report condescending or rude behavior.
quotes: the staff is genuinely friendly and upbeat
service was awful - this dude was super condescending in his tone and mannerisms

themes.label: Slow service
themes.text: Several reviewers report very long waits for food and drinks, sometimes over an hour, leaving food cold or orders cancelled.
quotes: ITS EXTREMELY SLOW. Waitresses are slow, food is slow, delivery is slow.
Took us over an hour and a half to get two cold crepes.

themes.label: Tea selection
themes.text: The tea menu is praised as large and excellent, served in pots, with some reviewers calling it phenomenal.
quotes: one gigazillion choices of tea (no baggies, just pots)
They have a great tea selection and give you an hourglass sand timer to steep your tea appropriately.

themes.label: Cozy upstairs atmosphere
themes.text: Reviewers like the cozy, cute, sunlit space and upstairs seating, though the space is small and the bathroom is hard to reach.
quotes: The sunlit upstairs is perfect for a quick bite or a long work session
Cute and cozy upstairs, great music and friendly staff.

themes.label: Donuts and baked goods
themes.text: Most reviewers rave about the donuts, cakes and pastries, though a few found them stale, dry or hard.
quotes: I'm convinced that any of their donuts/cakes/Pop tarts are winners.
The desserts are beautiful and creative, but they always taste very stale.

themes.label: Burgers and sandwiches
themes.text: Burgers and sandwiches, especially the Beast Mode and the tofu banh mi, are widely praised, with a few complaints about mess or being too spicy.
quotes: Good sloppy vegan burgers. What's not to love!

themes.label: Mac and cheese
themes.text: Some loved the mac and cheese, especially the jalapeño version, while others found the basic one bland, dry or flavorless.

it literally had no flavor at all

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Many found staff friendly and fast, but a few reported rude or distracted cashiers who were on their phones.
quotes: Also, very friendly service.
After helping the customer infront of me the cashier start typing on his phone.

themes.label: Price and portions
themes.text: Several reviewers found prices high for the portion, such as $12 burgers, while others called prices reasonable or worth it.
quotes: Food was good but you pay 12$ for one burger
Prices are reasonable and they serve sizeable portions.

themes.label: Friendly, attentive staff service
themes.text: Most reviewers praise friendly, fast and attentive staff, though one reviewer reported a very slow, poor experience on Mother's Day.
quotes: The wait staff was very friendly and attentive.
Friendly staff, a peaceful ambience and fast service make this an excellent choice for lunch.

themes.label: Chickpea fries
themes.text: Many call the chickpea fries unique, a must-try and flavorful, but others found them too salty, too much, or disappointing.
quotes: Chickpea fries are a must.
Chickpeas fries were highly disappointing, and sprout sandwich was too.

themes.label: Atmosphere and space
themes.text: Reviewers describe the room as peaceful, beautiful, clean and airy, and a good date spot, with plenty of seating.
quotes: surprisingly large space which is open and airy (vs cramped). Lots of seating.
beautiful atmosphere and location

themes.label: Desserts and baked goods
themes.text: Cakes, cookies and pastries are frequently praised, including cheesecake, carrot cake and the magic cookie, with one dislike of the strawberry shortcake.
quotes: Best coconut cream cheese cake there is.
Carrot cake is amazing for dessert

themes.label: Price and value
themes.text: Some find prices high for the portions, while others call the place affordable, reasonably priced or fair.
quotes: Feels a bit pricey for the quantity
Amazing vegan food, reasonably priced, in a chic modern environment.

themes.label: Vegan burger taste
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the burgers as delicious and satisfying, including to non-vegans, though a few found them bland or unremarkable.
quotes: Most delicious vegan burgers ever!
The non-vegans in our group were not at all missing meat and dairy.

themes.label: Friendly fast service
themes.text: Staff are widely described as friendly and service as quick, but two reviewers reported rude or cold staff and mistakes with their orders.

the vibe from the staff was terrible. Barely greeted us, the order was short two items

themes.label: Price and portion size
themes.text: Some find prices reasonable for vegan food in NYC, while others say the burgers are small and expensive.
quotes: Quick, vegan comfort food at an extremely reasonable price.
One piece of burger for $9! with fries up to $14! Not worth it at all.

themes.label: Mac and cheese
themes.text: Many call the vegan mac and cheese great, but a few reviewers found it not creamy or flavorful enough, or odd tasting.
quotes: The mac n cheese is the best vegan mac I've ever had.
it needs to be creamier and more flavorful

themes.label: Drumsticks and sides
themes.text: Reviewers enjoy the chicken-like drumsticks, crispy fries and dipping sauces.
quotes: The drumsticks smell like chicken, crunchy outside, moist and just right consistency inside.
The fries here are especially good since they're super crispy.

themes.label: Convincing mock meat

Their BBQ wings are a must try and surprisingly taste better than actual chicken.

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Many praise friendly, fast service, but others report rude or forgetful staff, slow service and limited staffing.
quotes: As soon as you walk in you are attended to and you do not have to wait long
The waitress just forgot about us....condiments, extra napkins....who need those?

themes.label: Prices and portions
themes.text: Reviewers find prices reasonable or affordable and portions large or filling.
quotes: The prices are very reasonable for mock meat.
Great price with large portions

themes.label: Long waits, small space
themes.text: The restaurant is small and packed, with long waits for a table, though some feel the food justifies it.
quotes: It's a small place and wait time is usually long... And thats because of their amazing food.
Long wait, and so worth the food once you know your way around the menu

themes.label: Inconsistent food quality

the main entrees sometimes feel like a gamble however

themes.label: Vegan pizza quality

I'm not even remotely vegan but holy mother of CHRIST, is this pizza delicious.

themes.label: Friendly staff and service
themes.text: Most reviewers describe friendly, helpful staff, but a few report rude or unhappy staff and poor service.
quotes: Staff was lovely and friendly and attentive
Service: Rude. They only had 2 pizzas when we came in

themes.label: Vegan cheese texture
themes.text: Several reviewers dislike the vegan cheese, calling it slimy, gluey, chewy or overpowering, though others find the pizza cheesy and good.

Extremely chewy vegan cheese and overly overpriced.

themes.label: Wings and sides
themes.text: Seitan buffalo wings and other sides, including desserts and knots, are praised, though one reviewer found the wings very spicy.
quotes: We had the wings and a two slices.
The Thai wings were definitely amazing , my fave !!!!!!

themes.label: High prices
themes.text: Some reviewers found prices steep for the pizza, while one called the price good.
quotes: Prices were a bit high end.
I asked why was it so expensive and they replied it's Vegan.

themes.label: Vegan chicken and sandwiches

This is honestly one of, if not THE best vegan chicken strip I've tried.

themes.label: Staff friendliness
themes.text: Most reviewers found the staff friendly and welcoming, but two reviewers described rude or snappy counter staff.

some of the staff had hella attitude

themes.label: Decor and atmosphere

The atmosphere is great, as is the decoration.

themes.label: Prices and value
themes.text: Some find prices high but worth it for the quality and portions, while others call them reasonable.
quotes: prices are high but I get the reason why
The prices are also a great value.

themes.label: Small seating space

quotes: The only downside is that there isn't a lot of room to sit.

cake was DRY, AND TASTELESS, kind of what I think cardboard would taste like

themes.label: Sandwiches and savory dishes

I had the worst burger of my life

themes.label: Staff and service
themes.text: Staff are mostly described as friendly and quick, but one reviewer had a bad cake-ordering experience and another had a poorly handled order.
quotes: Great vegan options -fantastic service
Really bad service and they lost a good business.

themes.label: Gluten-free options
themes.text: Many reviewers value the wide gluten-free range, though the gluten-free apple crumble and cupcakes were called not good or a little dry.
quotes: It also has great gluten free options.
Lots of gluten free options also available.

themes.label: Prices
themes.text: Several reviewers call it a little pricey, with one citing an overpriced burger, while others say prices are good or excellent.
quotes: a veggie burger priced similarly to a organic, pasture- raised beef burger just feels like robbery
Great selections at excellent prices.

themes.label: Creative tasty vegan sushi

quotes: Some of the most inventive and delicious vegan sushi I've ever had. Fantastic flavors, textures, everything.
AMAZING. Get the spicy mang roll. Or two.

themes.label: Small cramped seating
themes.text: Many reviewers say the space is tiny with few tables, cramped or awkward seating, and suggest takeout or avoiding big groups.
quotes: There are only 3 tables for 4 at this location so takeout is a good idea.
The venue itself is small and not suitable for big groups, so plan accordingly!

themes.label: Friendly fast service
themes.text: Staff are described as friendly, helpful and quick, though one reviewer found service not great in a small shop.
quotes: Great service and the staff is super friendly and helpful.
Friendly and fast service.

themes.label: Prices and value
themes.text: Most reviewers find prices reasonable or good value, while a few call the rolls pricey or the portions too small for the cost.
quotes: Incredible vegan sushi at very reasonable prices.
The portion size / price ratio is not very satisfying.

themes.label: Dumplings
themes.text: The dumplings are often singled out as a favorite, with one dissenting reviewer finding them floppy and too soft.

Dumplings were also very floppy and too soft.

themes.label: Vegan comfort food quality

The Best BLT a human will ever have. FACT

themes.label: Atmosphere and music

The only annoying thing is the music: great selection of tunes but too loud.

themes.label: Staff and service

to get our food took 2 hours to get(I had to remind them about us )

themes.label: Prices and value

themes.label: Service quality

themes.label: Service quality

themes.label: Low prices
themes.text: Many reviewers describe the food as cheap, reasonably priced or good value, often alongside decent portions.
quotes: The food here is delicious and very easy in the wallet.
Great Chinese take out at reasonable prices. Free soda after spending a certain amount.

themes.label: Delivery speed and driver
themes.text: Many call delivery fast, but others describe rude drivers, tip disputes, very long waits and food arriving cold.
quotes: great food .lightning fast delivery

themes.label: Food quality and freshness
themes.text: Most reviewers call the food tasty and fresh, but some report burnt, old, greasy or bad-smelling dishes.
quotes: The food is always fresh and delicious
the chicken wings were so old and burnt they were inedible, the broccoli was soggy and also tasted old

themes.label: Friendly attentive staff
themes.text: Many reviewers praise warm, friendly, fast and accommodating staff, though one complained of a snappy hostess and another of being ignored.
quotes: Good food, great atmosphere, friendly staff.
Walked in with a group of 14 and the staff couldn't have been more accommodating.

themes.label: Food quality
themes.text: Most reviewers call the food excellent, naming mussels, burgers, lobster mac and cheese and pasta, but some found it only okay or poorly cooked.
quotes: Amazing burgers, and the lobster Mac and cheese... Wow!
Decent food. Not amazing but a quite quaint dining experience in the seaport.

themes.label: Cozy decor and atmosphere
themes.text: Reviewers like the dark, cozy, woodwork-rich rooms and the vibe, though one found it a bit too dark.
quotes: Dark, cozy, comfortable and great food and service.
The venue is big but feels much more cosy and friendly than other places in the area.

themes.label: Drinks and bar
themes.text: Cocktails, beer, wine and bourbon selections and the bar are often praised, though one reviewer found cocktails average and another found limited draft beers.
quotes: The bar is enormous and perfect for single diners or couples to enjoy a really good US wine selection and local beers.

themes.label: Loud music and noise
themes.text: A few reviewers found the venue loud, making conversation difficult.
quotes: the relentless loud music makes it a terrible spot for eating or meeting with friends

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Many reviewers praise friendly, attentive staff, while others report slow service, long waits, and servers who disappeared at brunch or at the bar.
quotes: The wait staff were SO NICE, and literally every single dish was delicious.
While the food was good, the service was terribly slow.

themes.label: Brunch pancakes
themes.text: Pancakes are widely praised as the standout brunch item, though a few found them too sugary or more like lemon cakes.
quotes: The pancakes are crisped to perfection!
For my taste they are way to sugary.

themes.label: Prices and value
themes.text: Some find prices affordable, but many call the food pricey or overpriced for portion sizes, though several felt the quality justified it.
quotes: A little pricey but I will say the technique and flavors were on point so it was worth it.
Food was overpriced for the portion sizes, especially the egg and sausage sandwich.

themes.label: Wine and drinks
themes.text: Reviewers like the wine list, describing it as affordable, easy to navigate and well paired, with good cocktails.
quotes: nicely priced wine list, solid menu and great service.
Cocktails were strong, well-balanced, and delicious.

themes.label: Atmosphere and decor
themes.text: Reviewers describe a charming, cosy, relaxed space with good music, though one noted a hot room without air conditioning.
quotes: great cosy vibe, food and wine amazing.
Did not have the AC on even though it was extremely hot outside

themes.label: Buffet quality and variety
themes.text: Many reviewers praise the buffet or hot food bar for its variety, freshness and consistency, and like seeing the food before choosing; a few found it disappointing.
quotes: unlike other buffets where it's hit or miss, all of the dishes here are killer.
Loved the buffet style self serving option where you can see and smell the food you're choosing!

themes.label: Prices and value
themes.text: Some find prices reasonable or low, while others call the cafe pricey, and a few complain about buffet charges, menu price rises and delivery pricing.
quotes: Not a bad place, pretty expensive for what you get.
Really disappointed to see their menu has changed and prices up quite a bit seemingly overnight.

themes.label: Staff and service
themes.text: Most reviewers describe friendly, warm staff and good service, but some report slow, inattentive or ignoring staff and long cashier lines.
quotes: Staff is warm and friendly and the vibe is cool and chill
We went up to the counter and were ignored for awhile while the waiters kept pushing us aside

themes.label: Relaxed atmosphere and decor
themes.text: Reviewers like the chill, cozy and clean space, with art on the walls and a relaxing vibe.
quotes: The food is very delicious and the environment relaxing!
Beautiful indoor decor + proper ambiance.

themes.label: Old bank vault setting
themes.text: Reviewers love the historic downstairs dining room set in a former bank vault, calling it authentic, neat and memorable.
quotes: Can't get over the classic bank vault setting downstairs that was turned into a wonderful Steakhouse
It felt like walking into an old bank vault.

themes.label: Steak quality and doneness
themes.text: Many praise well-cooked, flavorful steaks, while several complain of undercooked, raw, tough or chewy cuts and a decline in quality.
quotes: Always a great rib eye perfectly cooked or lamb chops and attentive service
Steak was undercooked.. Very disappointed in the overall quality of the food.

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Many describe attentive, excellent service, but others report slow, inattentive or disinterested staff and long waits.
quotes: Great Food, excellent service.
The waiter took 15 minutes to take our drink order & another 15 minutes to take our food order.

themes.label: Price and value
themes.text: Some find it pricey or poor value for the money, while others say the quality justifies the cost or prices are fair.
quotes: A lil pricey but you definitely get your money's worth
You are better off going to Delmonicos or Capital Grille for same $.

themes.label: Bar and cocktails
themes.text: Reviewers praise the bartenders and strong drinks, especially martinis, though a couple found specific drinks average.
quotes: Authentic Wall Street bar with great cocktails especially martinis.
friendly bartender who makes great drinks

themes.label: Pizza quality and crust
themes.text: Many reviewers call it among the best pizza in NYC or downtown, praising the crust, sauce, cheese and ingredients, especially the old fashioned square pie.
quotes: Best pizza I've had in NYC. Don't waste time reading the menu just get the old fashioned with your favorite toppings.
One of the best pies I've ever had. The crust is perfect & very obviously prepared with high quality ingredients.

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Many praise fast, friendly, excellent service, but several describe unfriendly, rushing or rude servers and a manager dispute.
quotes: Great food and excellent service!
Knocking off two stars for the really obnoxious server who kept rushing us to order within 2 minutes of sitting down

themes.label: Outdoor Stone Street seating
themes.text: Reviewers enjoy sitting outside on Stone Street under the tent, though one disliked sharing a table with strangers.
quotes: looking for good pizza with great outdoor seating for small or large groups, this is your place.
having strangers sitting at the same table as us was not pleasant.

themes.label: Price and portion size
themes.text: Pizzas are large and can feed several people, but some find prices high, overpriced drinks, or extra charges for toppings.
quotes: Very expensive for the portions, however the amount that you get is delicious!
Pizzas run $27 to $35 but they can easily feed three people.

themes.label: Busy lunch crowd
themes.text: The restaurant gets crowded and loud at lunch with office workers, so some advise arriving early, and one noted tables are close together.
quotes: It gets crowded with office workers for lunch, but is the best pizza in the area.
Best pizza in NYC. Get there early for lunch

themes.label: Cozy atmosphere and fireplace
themes.text: Reviewers describe a cozy, homey, elegant room, with a fireplace and underground couches singled out.
quotes: Couches and a fireplace downstairs make this a cozy place to have a cup of tea or glass of wine.
very nice environment, elegant but not pretentious. tasting room with fireplace!

themes.label: Happy hour and drinks
themes.text: Happy hour deals and cocktails, wine and ale are mostly praised, though one early review called the cocktails really bad.
quotes: Happy hour drinks are a great deal.
Really bad cocktails, the barfood and atmosphere compensated a bit.

themes.label: Food quality and dishes
themes.text: Food is generally called good, with burgers, wings, nachos, sliders, lobster ravioli and French toast singled out, though a couple of reviewers found it only okay.
quotes: The French toast was amazing, and the burgers are great there as well.
Jerk spiced wings bring the heat.

themes.label: Prices
themes.text: Some reviewers found prices reasonable for Manhattan, while others thought the food was pricey outside of happy hour.
quotes: very reasonably priced for Manhattan.
The food was good, but a bit too pricey.

themes.label: Staff and service
themes.text: Service is mostly described as friendly, polite and accommodating, with one reviewer calling the waitress weird.
quotes: Staff were all polite and accommodating.
friendly and courteous service.

themes.label: Food quality
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the food as delicious, naming dishes such as duck confit, crepes, steak, mussels and scallops, though a few found dinner underwhelming.
quotes: Duck confit and Croque Madame were absolutely to die for!
The filet mignon was fantastic and the beef stew delicious as well.

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Many describe friendly, attentive staff, but several others report being ignored, very slow service, or a rude delivery call about tipping.
quotes: Service was top notch and attentive without being over bearing.
The waiter seated me, and proceeded to ignore me for 10 minutes, not even a glass of water.

themes.label: Garden and atmosphere
themes.text: Reviewers like the cozy, authentically French atmosphere and especially the back garden or patio seating.
quotes: The backyard is quiet and charming.
Love this place so cute backyard with many flowers

themes.label: Long waits
themes.text: Several reviewers describe waits of an hour or more for a table or for food, with little communication from staff.
quotes: they proceeded to take over an hour to make a crepe and an egg dish.
Said the wait was 20 minutes. We were sat 1 hr later after everyone else waiting left.

themes.label: Price and value
themes.text: Some find prices affordable and good value, while others call the menu pricey, overpriced or want smaller portions for a lower price.
quotes: Very good value for your dollar.
The dinner was overpriced and frankly underwhelming

themes.label: Friendly attentive service
themes.text: Most reviewers praise friendly, attentive staff and good service, though one review calls the servers fairly clueless and another dislikes the tipping.
quotes: The staff was friendly and attentive. The food was delicious!

themes.label: Fresh quality sushi
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly describe the sushi and sashimi as fresh, high quality and delicious, with omakase singled out, though a few found it mediocre or slimy.
quotes: The sushi here is very fresh and well presented.
Each time when I would do Omakase I would get different but super delicious selections.

themes.label: Prices and value
themes.text: Many call prices reasonable or fair for New York, while others find it pricey, note extra charges for tea and soup, or small portions.
quotes: Good, fresh, moderately priced for nyc.
Instead they charged $8 extra for miso soup and tea.

themes.label: Atmosphere and setting
themes.text: Reviewers like the cool, bright, comfortable room, the open-air feel and the views, though one found the ambiance lacking and another the place small.
quotes: the atmosphere is cool and comfortable. It's fun, bright, and the staff and owner are lovely
Great staff. Good was awesome. Ambiance not so much

themes.label: Fresh, tasty salads
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly praise the salads and bowls as fresh, flavorful and healthy, with particular mentions of dressings and specific dishes.
quotes: Hands down one of the healthiest food spots in the city with extremely tasty food.
Everything is delicious and fresh. Best farm to table.

themes.label: Long lunch lines
themes.text: Many reviewers warn of long, sometimes slow lines at lunchtime and suggest ordering ahead through the app.
quotes: I love this place, the only downfall is the massive wait at lunch time. My tip to you: order online or through the Sg app.
Plan to wait about 30 mins or more on a line to get your food.

themes.label: Staff and service
themes.text: Many reviewers describe friendly, fast staff, while others report rude, slow or error-prone service.
quotes: Unbelievably friendly staff! So professional that they make every effort to connect with the customers.
The service here is a joke. No one here gives AF.

themes.label: High prices
themes.text: Reviewers find the salads pricey, especially with add-ons, though some say the quality justifies the cost.
quotes: salads can get very pricey with all the add on's and the staff never seems to total up those add-on's correctly.
It's a few more dollars than the competition but worth it.

themes.label: Billing and order mistakes
themes.text: Some reviewers report being charged wrongly or receiving orders missing items they asked for.
quotes: If the salad includes something and they don't have it readily available, they will just not include it and still charge the whole price.

themes.label: Hand-pulled noodles
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the hand-pulled noodles as flavorful and bouncy, though one found them not chewy and another found them to be upsetting to the stomach.
quotes: The hand pulled noodles were so bouncy and flavorful!
Hand pulled noodles are outstanding!

themes.label: Reasonable prices
themes.text: Many reviewers describe the prices as reasonable or not expensive, especially for the Financial District area.
quotes: Pretty tasty and not too pricey for the area.
Great portions at great prices.

themes.label: Cleanliness and decor
themes.text: Reviewers describe the place as clean, tidy and modern, with a cozy or nice atmosphere.
quotes: The decor is clean and modern.
Extremely clean, cute atmosphere, friendly staff and really good food!

themes.label: Fast self-service ordering
themes.text: Reviewers like the quick service and kiosk ordering, though one found the assistant unhelpful and another noted single-use plastics.
quotes: The self service kiosk is a nice touch!

themes.label: Saltiness and spice
themes.text: Some reviewers found the food too salty, while others said the spice level was just right or warned that some dishes are spicy.
quotes: soup was so salty it was barely edible
Felt just spicy enough and the price is reasonable for the area

themes.label: Tofu and bento boxes
themes.text: Reviewers praise the tofu boxes for flavor, fresh vegetables, mushrooms and perfectly cooked tofu, with specific boxes like General Tso and drunken seitan singled out.
quotes: My General Tso tofo box came with four different types of sautéed mushrooms, steamed cauliflower and broccoli
The number 7 (drunken seitan) is incredibly good.

themes.label: Dumplings, noodles and sides
themes.text: Dumplings, hand-pulled noodles, mushroom skewers and soups are repeatedly named as standout items.
quotes: We had the spicy szechuan noodles and they were hand pulled and so delicious.
Mushroom skewers are hands down the best item on the menu.

themes.label: Portions and value
themes.text: Customers find the food filling, generously portioned and good value for the price.
quotes: Great food for the price. Very diverse and filling.
Quality food, amazing variety, excellent value!

themes.label: Friendly staff and service
themes.text: Staff and owners are described as friendly and kind, with fast service and delivery.
quotes: Very friendly staff. Food is always good and fast delivery
Super fast service, and you can tell they really care about freshness and flavor.

themes.label: Sweet sauces
themes.text: One reviewer found many of the sauces too sugary, though they said others who like sweetness and flavor might enjoy it.
quotes: a lot of the sauces were way to sugary for me

themes.label: Friendly, quick service
themes.text: Most reviewers praise friendly, attentive and fast staff, while a few report slow service, communication problems, hard-to-reach waiters or being seated awkwardly.
quotes: Friendly, attentive staff from the door to the table servers. We'll definitely come back again.
Service was quite slow and several wait staff had problems speaking and understanding English.

themes.label: Fresh healthy food
themes.text: Reviewers describe the food as fresh, healthy and tasty, with many vegetarian and vegan options and organic or naturally sourced ingredients.
quotes: I've never had a bad meal from them - all ingredients are always very fresh.
Great place with so many vegan options!

themes.label: Prices and portions
themes.text: Some find prices fair or reasonable for the area, while others call it pricey with small portions or poor value.
quotes: delicious and reasonably priced brunch on a Sunday on Wall Street
Portions were small and prices were high but it's to be expected for the area

themes.label: Burgers and chicken
themes.text: Chicken burgers, burgers and fries are often praised, but a few reviewers found burgers and chicken dishes mediocre, burnt, cold or tasteless.
quotes: Super good chicken burgers and equally good fries! Nice staff and clean tables!
I had the grilled chicken breast which was tasteless, cold, tiny and not even close to being worth the money

themes.label: Busy crowds and waits
themes.text: Reviewers note the restaurant gets crowded at lunch and sometimes has long waits, though one says a table was available despite being busy.
quotes: It definitely gets busy during weekday lunch hours so either go earlier or after lunch to avoid the crowd.
Busy but don't have to wait for a table

themes.label: Wide variety of options
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly praise the large range of stations and choices, including buffet, stir fry, salad bar, sushi and ramen.
quotes: their wide range of food stations ranging from the basic salad, to stir fry and even fresh rotisserie chicken
Open Kitchen's strength is in the number of options.

themes.label: Fast, efficient service
themes.text: Many describe quick checkout and fast service that suits a grab-and-go lunch, though a few found cashier service poor.
quotes: Food tastes so fresh! And service is always fast and efficient.
So fast. Perfect for grab and go lunch

themes.label: Prices and value
themes.text: Some find it expensive, citing a $13 fruit portion and pricey breakfast, while others call prices reasonable or affordable.
quotes: This little portion of fruit was $13. So overpriced. Avoid their weighted food selection, you will regret it!
Offers a great variety of options for a reasonable price

themes.label: Fresh, tasty food
themes.text: Reviewers describe the food as fresh and tasty, with the stir fry station singled out repeatedly as a favorite.
quotes: The stir-fry station is the best. Nice and fresh.
I love coming here to get the stir-fry. It's always so good that I come every chance I can

themes.label: Clean, spacious seating
themes.text: Several reviewers like the large, clean, open space and seating, though one found it too noisy and another noted limited indoor seating.
quotes: Huge space. Several options and choices.
It's a nice spacious clean place to sit in.

themes.label: Long wait times
themes.text: Many reviewers waited from 40 minutes to two hours for food; some left or rated low, while others said the wait was worth it.
quotes: Completely unreasonable wait time. Past closing time we were still waiting for our food.
Excellent food. The wait is long but worth it.

themes.label: Friendly staff and owner
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly describe the staff and the young owner as kind, welcoming and warm, even when they criticised other things.
quotes: The owner and her mom sooo sweet. Felt like I was at home.
They indeed have GREAT customer service and kept a positive attitude.

themes.label: Tasty vegan food
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the vegan dishes, especially the jackfruit panini, bacon egg and cheese, chick'n biscuit and mac and cheese.
quotes: the food was so delicious - the vegan Mac cheese was delightful and is a must try
First time having Jackfruit..must say it was delish! I will be back!

themes.label: Portions and prices
themes.text: Some found portions generous and prices good, while others found portions small or sandwiches pricey.
quotes: big generous portions for amazing prices! A treat for all vegans/vegetarians and those that love great food!
Portion size was a bit disappointing for $13!!

themes.label: Small cozy space
themes.text: Reviewers like the cozy, quaint atmosphere but note the place is tiny with few seats and hectic parking.
quotes: Small intimate setting not a lot of seats for dining in. Parking can be hectic.
Great flavor and it is a warm and cozy cafe.

themes.label: Curries and signature dishes
themes.text: Reviewers frequently praise the flavorful curries, especially pumpkin and fish curry, along with beef rendang, spring rolls and other small plates.
quotes: From the spring rolls to the pumpkin coconut curry and the amazing tempeh noodle dish: insanely delicious! Great service too.
Amazing cocktails and the fish curry was incredible. Will definitely become a regular.

themes.label: Authenticity of Indonesian food
themes.text: Some reviewers call it a creative, modern take on Indonesian food, while others say it is westernized, bland or not truly Indonesian.
quotes: But if you are looking for real Indonesian food you are at the wrong place.
The absolute best Indonesian restaurant in the city. Super rich and authentic flavors

themes.label: Price and portion size
themes.text: Several reviewers found the food pricey for small portions, though a few thought prices were fair or decent.
quotes: The priciness of it makes me dock it a star. The food and drinks were good, but not for the price.
Very small amount of food in general, especially few veggies, and I politely let them know.

themes.label: Friendly attentive staff
themes.text: Many reviewers describe the staff as friendly, helpful and quick, including accommodating vegan and allergy needs.
quotes: Every time I've gone, the service has been great and they were able to answer vegan questions about the menu.
There was fast and courteous service.

themes.label: Ambiance and decor
themes.text: Reviewers like the airy, plant-filled, cozy room and good vibes, though a couple found it too bright or too quiet.
quotes: Great music, plants everywhere, very airy.
it makes for a fresh and beachy atmosphere.

themes.label: Shawarma quality
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the shawarma as fresh, tender and among the best they have had, though one found it dry.
quotes: Unlike some other places, they use real cuts of meat and real pita pockets for the sandwiches.
Dry shawarma is a total bummer.

themes.label: Falafel
themes.text: Falafel is repeatedly called delicious and among the best, with crispy outside, fluffy inside, generous sandwiches and plates.
quotes: Crispy on the outside, fluffy and creamy on the inside.
you can never beat an overflowing Falafel sandwich for 4 bucks

themes.label: Low prices
themes.text: Reviewers describe the food as cheap, reasonably priced and good value, with large portions, though one notes prices have gone up.
quotes: Prices are cheap when you look at what your getting. Portions are huge.
Always good, simple food. Done well and priced perfectly

themes.label: Cleanliness
themes.text: Some reviewers found the place exceptionally clean, while others reported dirt, dead flies and even pests and food poisoning.
quotes: Exceptionally clean, great service and delicious food. Love this place.
loads of dead flies and bees along the window sill is gross

themes.label: Service
themes.text: Most describe fast, friendly service and nice staff, but one called it horrible and another noted a worker ignoring customers for a phone.
quotes: No frills, fast and friendly service. Tasty food.
THIS PLACE IS HORRIBLE- HORRIBLE SERVICE

themes.label: Hummus quality
themes.text: Most reviewers call the hummus among the best they have had, praising its texture and authenticity, though one found it over-salted and lacking lemon.
quotes: This place has the most authentic hummus I've had, and my husband and I have been searching through all of the major Manhattan hummus places.
The hummus is over-salted and doesn't have enough lemon juice. I couldn't finish it because of how salty it was.

themes.label: Service
themes.text: Many reviewers describe friendly, fast service, but others report slow, inattentive or indifferent staff and long waits to be served or get food.
quotes: The food was great and service was fast and friendly
Upon seating us our server didn't once check in on us, let alone even look in our direction.

themes.label: Fresh food
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly say the ingredients and dishes are very fresh and well presented.
quotes: Everything was super fresh and beautifully presented.
They use very fresh ingredients, everything is made fresh to order.

themes.label: Backyard patio
themes.text: The back garden or patio is repeatedly described as nice, quiet and a reason to visit.
quotes: The backyard is really nice, so is the food!
Delicious food in the quiet garden.

themes.label: Vegan and allergy mistakes
themes.text: Two reviewers say vegan or egg-free requests were ignored, with egg served in their dishes and staff seeming indifferent.
quotes: Despite specifying an egg allergy they put egg whites in the bottom of the pita.
Orders the vegan version of the fallafel in which they included eggs...they seemed relatively indifferent.

themes.label: Convincing meat substitutes
themes.text: Reviewers are repeatedly surprised at how closely the vegetarian mock meats taste like real chicken, pork and other meats.
quotes: The mock meats taste like the real thing.
For a all veggie place, I was really surprised by how much some of the dishes tasted like meat!

themes.label: Vegetarian dim sum
themes.text: Many reviewers praise the vegan and kosher dim sum as among the best, though one found the dim sum dough too doughy.
quotes: Hands down the best vegan dim sum you will find.
Good vegetarian dim sum is really hard to find, especially if you're not in a vegetarian restaurant.

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Many describe friendly, fast service, while others report rude hosts, slow or inattentive staff, and a forced tip.
quotes: The food tasted great and the service was amazing despite the huge amount of people in the restaurant.
terrible experience..very rude behavior from host..definitely not coming back

themes.label: Large portions, good value
themes.text: Reviewers note big, shareable portions and affordable prices, often leaving with leftovers.
quotes: I don't think I've ever left this place without leftovers.
The food is tasty and the the price is decent for the amount of food you get.

themes.label: Kosher and vegan menu
themes.text: Reviewers value the kosher, vegetarian and mostly vegan menu with a wide selection of dishes.
quotes: Most dishes are vegan, if not it is declared on the menu (dairy, with egg).

themes.label: Tamale quality and authenticity
themes.text: Reviewers praise the tamales as flavorful, generously filled and authentically Mexican, with a wide choice of fillings; one found the masa slightly bland.
quotes: Tamal de Rajas con Queso. It was as good as the ones my mom makes in MX D.F.
The tamales I tried were fantastic - the masa was light and the fillings generous.

themes.label: Low prices and value
themes.text: Most reviewers find the food cheap and good value, though one called the tamales very expensive.
quotes: They're so reasonably priced and was the cheapest meal I had in Manhattan outside of Chinatown.
It was good but very expensive for tamales.

themes.label: Friendly staff and service
themes.text: Staff and the family owners are described as friendly, welcoming and quick, with great customer service.
quotes: Delicious food and the nicest folks you'll ever meet.
Fast and friendly service.

themes.label: Breakfast sandwiches and tortas
themes.text: Breakfast sandwiches, paninis and tortas are singled out as tasty, with the sausage egg sandwich especially praised.
quotes: Excellent spot to get a breakfast sandwich, super tasty, especially with the hot sauce!
The sausage breakfast sandwich here is one of the best morning food options

themes.label: Small space, limited seating
themes.text: Many call the place small with sparse seating, unsuited to large groups, though one reviewer found plenty of seating and others found it cozy and clean.
quotes: The space is small and there is sparse seating so not suited for a large group.
Plently of seating. Very cozy.

themes.label: Food quality
themes.text: Many reviewers call the food delicious or tasty, with seafood, Cuban sandwich, yuca chips and appetizers singled out, though a few found dishes poor.
quotes: Had a Cuban sandwich. It was very tasty and was pretty big. The pork was really good and it was toasted just right.
I had the shrimp Mozambique and buffalo wings, both were delicious.

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Many describe friendly, quick, courteous staff, but others report awful service, inattentive waiters and unhelpful management.
quotes: Staff is very friendly. Service is quick and on point.
Very bad service. It took more than an hour to get the food we order.

themes.label: Long waits for food
themes.text: Several reviewers waited 40 minutes to over an hour for their food, sometimes with the restaurant not busy.
quotes: Waited 45 minutes for a quesadilla and some of the rest of the group I was with for a salad.
Waited forever for the food and the restaurant wasn't even very busy.

themes.label: Rodizio meat experience
themes.text: Some love the all-you-can-eat meat at a reasonable price, while others say the rodizio was stale, limited, rotten or cut short.
quotes: Incredible grilled meats, and plenty of them! All-You-Can-Eat meat, for a VERY reasonable price.
They literally brought us couple pieces of meat and came to take our plates.

themes.label: Atmosphere and decor
themes.text: Reviewers like the decor, ambiance and spacious, pleasant setting, including music, TVs and holiday decorations.
quotes: You step in and the place is incredibly decorated. Dim lighting with amazing detail to metalwork
Nice holiday decorations, nice ambiance, great tap beer, good food, good service

themes.label: Friendly, attentive service
themes.text: Most reviewers praise friendly, attentive, quick staff, though a few describe rude, moody or inattentive service, especially on the phone.
quotes: Great food, dependable service, family owned spot. My coffee cup is never empty
Absolutely awful service. Horrible

themes.label: Food quality
themes.text: Many call the food good or delicious, but others report greasy, undercooked, dry or rancid dishes and some find it only average.
quotes: I had the most delicious Lox Benedict of my life.
The food is extremely greasy.

themes.label: Fair, cheap prices
themes.text: Many reviewers describe prices as cheap, fair or reasonable, though one found it pricey and another thought pancakes not worth $20.
quotes: Great breakfast food at wonderful prices.
very reasonable prices....fast service....

themes.label: Delivery and phone orders
themes.text: Reviewers report very long delivery waits, rude phone handling, overcooked food and lost or mishandled orders, though one praised on-time delivery.
quotes: I live 4 blocks away and it took them over an hour to deliver
Delivery took an 1.5 hours for apartment less than 12 minutes walk.

themes.label: Classic diner atmosphere
themes.text: Reviewers like the cozy, homey, authentic old-fashioned diner feel of the place.
quotes: Cool little diner that really has that diner feel.
