quotes: The service was attentive and friendly. Neighborhood gem.
no one at the counter ever helped us or took our order either. Ended up leaving without getting anything.

themes.label: Price and portion size
themes.text: Reviewers find the desserts small and expensive for what they are, though some still consider them very good.
quotes: Listen, its beautiful. Its delicious. Its insanely expensive.
here the desserts are daintily small but the bill is large.

themes.label: Open kitchen bar seating
themes.text: Guests enjoy watching desserts being made at the bar, though seating is limited and not suited to larger groups.
quotes: It is bar style seating where u can watch the pastry chefs making and prepare the food.
Bar seating only, cool to see the pastry chef assembling but not ideal for more than a party of 2 people.

themes.label: Presentation and plating
themes.text: Reviewers admire the artistic, stylish look of the pastries and plates, though one wanted better plating.
quotes: Minimal, subtle but sophisticated flavors combined with artsy plate design.
Presentation is everything! They master it.

themes.label: Atmosphere and decor
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly praise the cozy, vintage, romantic 1920s-style interior and relaxed, welcoming feel, though a few find the seating uncomfortable or tiny.
quotes: I was like being transported to Paris in the 1920's.
Cozy but warm and welcoming. Super friendly staff and tasty cocktails.

themes.label: Live music
themes.text: Reviewers enjoy the live music, often mentioned on Saturdays, as a key part of the place's appeal.
quotes: The live music makes this place truly special.
Live music on Saturdays. Great for a date.

themes.label: Food and vegan dishes
themes.text: Most reviewers find the vegan food delicious, naming dishes like fettuccini, artichoke pizza and portobello burger, though brunch plates drew some complaints.
quotes: The fettuccini was absolute perfection, and you wouldn't guess that it's vegan if you didn't already know.
The portobello burger is the best burger in NYC

themes.label: Cocktails and happy hour
themes.text: Cocktails and happy hour deals are widely praised as unique and good value, with one reviewer finding their cocktail and wine unremarkable.
quotes: Happy hour is fantastic. The best cocktails for $10!
I didn't particularly like my cocktail and the wine was average.

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Many reviewers describe friendly, great service, but a few report being ignored, rude staff, or very long waits for food.
quotes: Sat for 10 minutes and was completely ignored by any and all wait staff.

themes.label: Juice quality and taste
themes.text: Reviewers praise the juices and smoothies as delicious, fresh and addictive, with one calling them the best in the world.
quotes: OMG I love their juice so much can't live without it
Healthy fresh cold pressed juices. Also packaged raw food is available.

themes.label: Staff and customer service
themes.text: Most reviewers describe helpful, nice staff and excellent service, but two recent reviews report a rude worker and a cashier who refused a late sale.
quotes: The people In the store are nice and willing to take time to help you
The person working here horrible and Rude. No energy.

themes.label: Price and value
themes.text: Two reviewers found the drinks pricey though worth the quality, while another said it offers the most bang for your buck.
quotes: Juice/smoothy was deliciousness if a bit pricey, but I get that quality costs $$$.
Best juice in the world, most bang for your buck

themes.label: Closing time and availability
themes.text: One reviewer arriving 20 minutes before closing was told no juice was left because everything had already been washed.
quotes: they close at 8 PM and I arrived at 7:40 to buy some juices and the cashier told me that he washed everything already

themes.label: Friendly, welcoming staff
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly describe the staff and owners as friendly, kind and welcoming, often Italian and family-run.
quotes: Very hospitable owners. The food is delicious.
The staff was very friendly and welcoming as well.

themes.label: Piadine flatbread sandwiches
themes.text: Piadine are praised as delicious, authentic and among the best people have had, with quality meats and cheeses.
quotes: Best Piadinas I've ever had.
The piadina is amazing. So sad I can't give 10 stars.

themes.label: Coffee quality
themes.text: Most reviewers call the coffee and espresso excellent, though one wants better beans and another found the coffee station badly laid out.
quotes: Very good quick bite and excellent espresso coffee
please have nice coffee beans!

themes.label: Cozy rustic decor
themes.text: The room is described as cozy, eclectic and old-school Italian, with knickknacks, toys and table games adding charm.
quotes: Cozy, rustic feel with old toys for kids to play with.
cozy cute cafe with nicknacks and fun stuff to look at on every wall.

themes.label: Ordering, crowding and seating
themes.text: Some found ordering chaotic, slow or crowded with limited seating, while others found service fast and the no-frills setup fine.
quotes: A little chaotic ordering and paying but that just adds to the authenticity
Get in early if you want a seat.

themes.label: Pizza quality
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the slices, especially cheese and Sicilian, as among the best in Greenpoint or Brooklyn, while some call them mediocre or declining.
quotes: Possibly the best standard slice pizza in Greenpoint.
This pizza was extremely mediocre. They reheat the slices way too hot that it just destroys the pizza

themes.label: Prices
themes.text: Many reviewers find the slices expensive or rising in price, though a few describe the pizza as cheap or fairly priced.
quotes: Hope you dont mind paying $8 for 2 slices of mediocre pizza.
Prices keep rising. Cheese slice now cost 2.75, and any topping slice costs 4.00

themes.label: Staff and service
themes.text: Some describe friendly, welcoming staff and a nice owner, while others report rude counter staff, creepy behavior, and poor customer service.
quotes: Friendly staff, great food.
Unfriendly staff, horrible costumer service, and overpriced pizza.

themes.label: Garlic knots and sides
themes.text: Garlic knots are repeatedly singled out as a highlight, with zeppoles, pepperoni rolls and other sides also getting praise.
quotes: the garlic knots are to die for!
I like their zeppoles the best from the pizza places near me.

themes.label: Cleanliness and hygiene
themes.text: Several reviewers complain about hygiene, including staff handling food without gloves or washing hands, no masks, and a place that could be cleaner.
quotes: Please use gloves or sanitize your Hand before you touch slice pizza for customers
This place definitely deserve 5 stars but it can be more clean.

themes.label: Food taste and quality
themes.text: Most reviewers call the vegan food delicious and creative, including meat-like dishes, and say even non-vegans enjoyed it, though a few found some dishes bland or salty.
quotes: you will be blown away with how delicious this food is!!
I was reluctant to go here, because I'm very NOT vegan. Everything here was DELICIOUS!

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Service is mostly described as friendly, knowledgeable and accommodating, though one reviewer noted only one efficient waiter and another felt servers pushed extra food and wine.
quotes: Great food, Excellent Service very friendly staffs
Very knowledgeable staff. Will for sure return.

themes.label: Ambiance and atmosphere
themes.text: Reviewers describe the room as cozy, peaceful, romantic and pretty, suited to a quiet dinner, with one finding the interiors not very impressive.
quotes: The ambiance was peaceful and cozy, and the service impeccable.
nice place for a quiet dinner date.

themes.label: Pricey for vegetarian
themes.text: Many call it expensive, with some saying the quality justifies the cost and others saying it is too much for veggie food.
quotes: A little pricey but worth it to indulge in a gourmand's dream
Was very good restaurant but very expensive, could be cheaper

themes.label: Brunch and desserts
themes.text: Brunch dishes such as tofu eggs and vegan Benedict drew praise, while the French toast was small and some desserts were disappointing.
quotes: Excellent brunch menu and tea selection
Extremely tough cake with vanilla frosting that tasted like lemon frosting.

themes.label: Steak quality
themes.text: Most reviewers call the porterhouse and steak outstanding, often the best in New York, though a few find it overrated or only okay.
quotes: As good as it gets. Don't know why they even bother putting salt and pepper on the table.
Definitely New York's best steak by a mile.

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Many praise friendly, attentive waiters, but others describe rude, arrogant or unprofessional servers and a curt reception.
quotes: the service is top notch delivered by old school waiters
Arrogant waiters, treating without caring and attention with customers.

themes.label: High prices
themes.text: Reviewers note the high cost; many say it is worth it, while some call it overpriced or a trap.
quotes: Expensive, yes, but it's totally worth it.
slightly over priced but overall worth a visit

themes.label: Waits and reservations
themes.text: Reviewers report long waits, seating delays despite bookings, and difficulty getting a reservation.
quotes: We had a reservation but still waited about 30 minutes for our table
we weren't seated until nearly 15 minutes after our booking

themes.label: Bacon and sides
themes.text: The thick-cut bacon, creamed spinach and onion rings earn praise, though one reviewer found the sides mediocre.
quotes: The bacon is amazingly thick, crunchy and flavorful.
Skip the sides they're mediocre at best.

themes.label: Food quality
themes.text: Many reviewers call the food delicious, fresh and some of the best Thai they have had, though a few find it mediocre, not authentic or declining.
quotes: Everything is unbelievably delicious and fresh
One of the best Pad Thai's I've had since Thailand!! Romantic ambience, great service.

themes.label: Atmosphere and decor
themes.text: Reviewers praise the atmosphere, decor and romantic date-night feel, though some say it is too dark.
quotes: Delicious food. Romantic atmosphere. Helpful staff. Everything you need for a quintessential date night in W'burg!
Great Brooklyn spot to eat... atmosphere is perfect.... Thai Restaurant...

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Most reviewers find staff friendly, attentive and accommodating, but others report slow, inattentive, rushed or unpleasant service.
quotes: We had a hard time getting our waiter or anyone to see us.

themes.label: Prices and value
themes.text: Earlier reviews call prices cheap and good value, while later ones say it has become pricey with smaller portions.
quotes: youre getting less than before and paying more so not wortth my drive
it is also not very expensive, I felt that it is very cheap

themes.label: Noise and music
themes.text: Some find the DJ and house music too loud or unpleasant, while others enjoy the music and DJ nights.
quotes: You have to get used to eating your food while a dj spins obnoxiously loud house music.
Awesome food & live dj spinning house/techno

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Many praise quick, friendly service, while others report rude, inattentive or incompetent staff and a cashier or waitress with an attitude.
quotes: service is very quick and waiters are very pleasant
Staff was lazy, quality of food was poor and I got charged for food I ordered but did not receive

themes.label: Food quality
themes.text: Opinions split: some call the food good or great, many find it just okay or average, and others find it poor, dry or undercooked.
quotes: Food was decent nothing to rave about
my girl's food (egg and cheese omelette and hash) was really undercooked and inedible.

themes.label: Large portions
themes.text: Several reviewers like the huge portions, though a couple say the portions were small for the price.
quotes: They serve big portions, even for the kids menu.
Judging from the portion of food my friend got, it wasn't a lot.

themes.label: Pricing
themes.text: Several reviewers describe the diner as pricey or overpriced for what they get, though one says there is plenty of food for a reasonable price.
quotes: While the food is edible its extremely over priced.
A bit overpriced and the service isn't ideal.

themes.label: Open 24 hours
themes.text: Reviewers value that the diner is open at all hours and is a handy option for late-night food.
quotes: I came in at three am and was still able to order anything from over a hundred choices.
Still the best spot for late night bites in the area!

themes.label: Pastrami and sandwich quality
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the pastrami, corned beef and Reuben as tender, flavorful and the best they've had, though a few find them overhyped.
quotes: Best pastrami in the world. A must everytime I'm in New York!
the meat is incredibly flavory and tender. This is a must go in NY.

themes.label: Long lines and waits
themes.text: Many describe long, crowded lines but say they move quickly and are worth it; others find the ordering slow and disorganized.
quotes: Long lines but worth the wait.
Always busy but lines move quickly.

themes.label: Huge portions
themes.text: Sandwiches and fries are very large, and reviewers often suggest sharing one between two people.
quotes: Portions were huge. I'd recommend splitting a sandwich.
sandwiches so thick you will not go hungry

themes.label: High prices
themes.text: Many call the sandwiches expensive, around $20 or more, though several say the quality justifies the cost.
quotes: It may be $20 for a sandwich and a couple pickles- but it is WORTH it, at least once!
it's food is way overrated and expensive

themes.label: Ticket system and ordering
themes.text: Some visitors found the ticket system, multiple lines and self-seating confusing or overwhelming.
quotes: A little confusing where to go, which line is which.
you need to know the system if your going to order and seat yourself

themes.label: Pizza taste and crust
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the thin, crispy New York-style slice, its sauce and flavor, though a few call it mediocre, burned or heavy.
quotes: Simply great New York style pizza. Crispy thin crust, huge slice with great balance of ingredients.
Not greasy, nice and thin, and perfect. That tomato sauce is seriously like no other.

themes.label: Crowds, lines and seating
themes.text: Reviewers describe busy late-night crowds and lines that move fast, but the space is small with very few seats.
quotes: At night there is always a line, but it moves pretty fast.
I wish they had more seats. They only have like 3 seats.

themes.label: Customer service
themes.text: Many describe fast, friendly and helpful staff, while one reviewer found them rude and unhelpful and another complained about slow delivery.
quotes: Classic NYC-style slice, very quick service. Guys at the counter were on the ball, and good at their jobs.
They were not helpful at all and were even rude when we asked for help

themes.label: Price and value
themes.text: Some find the slices cheap and fair for the quality, while others call them overpriced or typical NYC pricing.
quotes: Really good pizza at a fair price.
Pizza isn't bad but not worth the price. Overrated and overpriced

themes.label: Late-night hours
themes.text: Reviewers value that it is open late and works well for a slice after a night out.
quotes: Great pizza open until late hours

themes.label: Chicken and waffles
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly call the fried chicken and waffles the standout dish, with many naming it the best they have had, though a few found the chicken overcooked.
quotes: the best fried chicken I've had outside of New Orleans, paired with the best waffles outside of Belgium

themes.label: Long waits, small space
themes.text: Reviewers say the room is small, crowded and loud, with long waits especially at brunch and no reservations.
quotes: The place is small so there will be a wait, especially at brunch.
you may be elbow to elbow with other customers, especially if it's busy

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Most reviewers describe friendly, attentive staff and bartenders, but a few report horrible, distant or inconsistent service.
quotes: Very attentive waitress with a great personality.
Food is great; however the service is horrible.

themes.label: Prices and billing
themes.text: Some reviewers find prices high for what is served, and others report tipping confusion or being charged more than they wrote on the bill.
quotes: Things cost too much for what they are $4 for a can of soda and $17 for a cut waffle and 2 pieces of chicken
beware you MUST tip separately it's not included in the bill

themes.label: Drinks and music
themes.text: Reviewers praise the cocktails, bartenders and playlist, though one found the drinks small, weak and overpriced.
quotes: Phenomenal chicken and waffles. Great mixed drinks too.
Super-friendly bartenders, and the music selection was amazing!

themes.label: Cheesecake quality
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the cheesecake as delicious and the best they have had, though a few found it crumbled, sour, or only okay.
quotes: Mind blowing New York cheesecake. It's a must try!
the cheesecake was horrible. It was all crumbled up in pieces.

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Many describe friendly, fast, attentive service, but some report slow service, an unwelcoming staff member, or mistakes with orders.
quotes: The service is as good as it gets here and the food was delicious.
Even though it was empty service was pretty slow, and the waitress messed up the drinks.

themes.label: Large portions
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly mention generous, huge portions of food and desserts.
quotes: The portions are HUGE!! We had the steak burgers with Swiss. So good!
they always give generous portions and the food is really fresh.

themes.label: Prices and value
themes.text: Some find prices reasonable or fair, while others call them high or not worth the quality of the meals.
quotes: The cheesecake is great...but the prices are kinda high.

themes.label: Savory food quality
themes.text: Opinions on non-dessert food vary: some praise burgers, sandwiches and onion rings, while others found meals average, cold, stale or spoiled.
quotes: Best onion rings I've ever come across.
Ordered pastrami bread was stale so disappointed.

themes.label: Fried chicken and biscuits
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the fried chicken and chicken biscuits as the best they have had, though a few found the chicken dry or bland.
quotes: Perfect fried chicken, and the biscuits here are to die for.
Best fried chicken in Brooklyn. Well seasoned crispy fried chicken.

themes.label: Pies and donuts
themes.text: Pies and donuts, especially banana cream pie and the pecan donut, are widely praised, with one reviewer finding the pecan pie and donut unimpressive.
quotes: You's a fool if you ain't try the pie yet!
The Pecan donut is banging!

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Most describe friendly, excellent service and staff, but some report slow service, a snooty waiter, or uncomfortable stares from workers.
quotes: Owners and staff are all friendly and accomodating.

themes.label: Waits and crowds
themes.text: Reviewers mention queues and crowding, with some saying the wait is worth it or shorter than quoted, and others finding it too long.
quotes: Long queues but worth the wait.
Don't worry, the wait is never as long as they say it is.

themes.label: Prices
themes.text: Several reviewers found the prices too high for the portions, though a couple called them low or reasonable.
quotes: 16 for 3 piece of chicken nooooooo not loving that
Good chicken but so over priced.

themes.label: Variety of vendors and food
themes.text: Reviewers praise the wide range of food stalls, shops and cuisines, from groceries and meat to prepared food and coffee, all under one roof.
quotes: A conglomerate of independent stores, great grocery shopping, fish market, fruits and vegetables, meat market, breads, coffees, cheeses.
A great assortment of restaurants, and market-style shops. A great place to go and grab a bite with friends.

themes.label: Fresh produce and groceries
themes.text: Shoppers say the fruit, vegetables, meat and fish are fresh and good for everyday grocery shopping.
quotes: Excellent place to get fresh fruits and vegetables and from different countries
Fresh fruit and vegetables Meats and Seafood at great prices

themes.label: Prices
themes.text: Some find prices reasonable or cheaper than supermarkets, while others say the new market has become pricey, with some vendors very expensive.
quotes: It seems a bit pricier, but you can't fault them for that.
You can get lunch there for under $10 and enjoy the ambiance of the space!

themes.label: New space and seating
themes.text: Many like the new, clean, spacious building with plenty of seating, though some miss the old market and one wants more seating and bathrooms.
quotes: Great quality and huge space upstairs for sitting.
I wish they had more seating and an easy to find bathroom.

themes.label: Old market nostalgia
themes.text: Several reviewers miss the old market's character, though many are glad the community feel and vendors were largely kept.
quotes: Beautiful new space, and great to see lots of the old vendors still there!
While I love the openness of this new location, it really makes me miss the old one.

themes.label: Live music and venue
themes.text: Reviewers praise the live music, sound and concert setting, though a few criticise the layout, sound, loud volume or a late start.
quotes: Unquestionably the best venue in the city for general admission shows.
Big stage, big sound, love it here!

themes.label: Food and fried chicken
themes.text: The food, especially the fried chicken, is widely praised as excellent, with only occasional comments that it is pricey.
quotes: Great chicken! hands down for real!
The food was better than the bowling. Very slippery balls, but EXCELLENT FOOD!

themes.label: Long waits for bowling
themes.text: Reviewers report long waits for lanes, no reservations, and frustration over extra bowling charges after paying entry.
quotes: excessively long waits for bowling (plus they don't take reservations)
We waiting almost 2 hours to bowl then when it was time to bowl, they told us we had to pay $25

themes.label: High prices
themes.text: Many find drinks, food and bowling overpriced, while others call drinks and tickets cheap or fairly priced.
quotes: Drinks and food are super overpriced.
Always a great lineup and cheap tickets.

themes.label: Staff and service
themes.text: Many describe friendly, attentive staff and bar service, but some report rude treatment, poor management and too few bartenders.
quotes: good selection of beers and attentive staff.
they can be pretty rude to customers

themes.label: Beer selection
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly praise the wide range of German, European and rare beers on tap and in bottles, with only one wishing for more.
quotes: Incredible beer selection (I always love that they have the rare, imported fruity types)
Great food and TONS of beer choices

themes.label: Sausages and pretzels
themes.text: Bratwurst, grilled sausages, big pretzels and a range of mustards are widely singled out as highlights of the food.
quotes: Great pretzel and outstanding grilled sausages..
a sausage grill with 6 different mustards - this is the perfect beer hall.

themes.label: Atmosphere and live music
themes.text: Reviewers enjoy the lively beer-hall and garden vibe, the space for large groups, and the live music or DJs, though some find it loud or crowded.
quotes: Live music in front, biergarten in the back. Gotta say I loved the vibe of this place
It's a little too cavernous and dark for Summer outings.

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Some praise attentive, professional staff and bartenders, while others report unresponsive, slow or uninterested servers.
quotes: every single waitstaff member exceeded expectations by a mile. As soon as I had finished a drink they were already handing me another
the server only came to our table to take our initial order, then to bring us our food.

themes.label: Food quality and price
themes.text: Most find the food tasty and hearty, but one reviewer found it poor quality and expensive, and others call it only ok or pricey.
quotes: Too expensive to get such poor quality food.
Food obviously not healthy but tasty and consistent.

themes.label: Long waits for tables
themes.text: Reviewers report waits of an hour or more at busy times and advise booking ahead or taking counter seats, though some still found it worth it.
quotes: Worth the wait.... best scramble eggs
Good food, portions are small, the wait is insane and the menu gets boring after a while

themes.label: Pancakes
themes.text: Most reviewers loved the thick, fluffy pancakes with praline or malted chocolate, but others found them dry or disappointing.
quotes: The triple stack pancakes were delicious. The hazelnut praline was just the right amount of sweetness
they don't cook them fresh per order and ours were dryer than stale bread

themes.label: Cocktails and drinks
themes.text: Cocktails are widely praised as creative, well presented and varied, though a few reviewers found drinks pricey or disliked one.
quotes: Inventive dishes, great cocktails and a thoughtful wine list makes this spot one of my favorites in the neighborhood
This place has amazing cocktails, and a great environment.

themes.label: High prices, small portions
themes.text: Reviewers describe the restaurant as expensive, especially drinks, and some say portions are small, though a few feel quality justifies the cost.
quotes: portions not very large but offset by the high quality of the raw materials
drinks are too high and menu is boring

themes.label: Cozy atmosphere and decor
themes.text: Many describe the room as cozy, cute and stylish with a good vibe, including the seasonal holiday pop-up.
quotes: Decor is relaxed and has a good vibe.
the ambience is cozy and cute

themes.label: Waterfront and bridge views
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly praise the views of the Brooklyn and Manhattan bridges, the river and the city skyline, especially from the pier end and rooftop.
quotes: Three bridge scene is unbeatable with a drink from the Heineken bar.
Best view of the city especially at sun down

themes.label: Concerts and events
themes.text: Many visitors came for rooftop concerts and events and found it a great venue, though some had complaints about sound and entry lines.
quotes: Great place for a concert. Must go to
Here for Ringo Starr anf his All Star Band, a great concert venue.

themes.label: Limited shops and food
themes.text: Several reviewers found few shops, restaurants or things to do, with the old mall gone and the development still unfinished.
quotes: Great venue. Lack of food options though.
I'm disappointed that the mall isn't even a mall anymore.

themes.label: Rooftop ice skating
themes.text: Visitors enjoyed the elevated ice skating rink in winter, calling it amazing and fun.
quotes: Rooftop ice skating was amazing!
So much fun and I absolutely love the ice skating rink!

themes.label: Staff, security and queues
themes.text: A few reviewers complained about poor service, long security lines and unenforced no-smoking rules, while one praised helpful staff and funny bartenders.
quotes: A 30 minute queue for security is unacceptable.
Great space and helpful staff! Had a blast here, can't wait to go back!

themes.label: Pizza taste and crust
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the thin, crisp-chewy crust and flavorful cheese slice as authentic New York pizza, though a few call it ordinary, burnt or soggy.
quotes: Awesome pizza. The crust is crunchy and chewy at the same time.
Excellent new york style pizza. Thin, crispy with the right amount of flavour.

themes.label: Fast service
themes.text: Reviewers say staff work quickly and the line moves fast, making it good for a quick bite.
quotes: Don't be afraid of lines as the workers are very efficient and the line moves in a matter of minutes.
They are working supeeer fast so if you are in a hurry this place is definitely recommended for quick stops.

themes.label: Price and value
themes.text: Some find slices good value at about $3-4, while others call it pricey or overpriced for what they get.
quotes: $4.00 for a large slice. $2.00 for a soda. Good deal in the middle of times Square
This midtown location is especially bad and overpriced.

themes.label: Crowds and seating
themes.text: The shop is crowded with long lines and very little seating, so most people eat standing or outside.
quotes: The pizza is very good but it is impossible to find a place to sit.
Only 2 tables and a small counter that you can stand and eat

themes.label: Overrated hype
themes.text: Some reviewers felt the pizza was good but not exceptional and did not live up to its reputation.
quotes: the pizzas are good without being exceptional
Pizza is just OK: not bad, but not worth falling in line for

themes.label: Overall pizza quality vs name
themes.text: Many call it the best pizza or a perfect slice, while others find it bland, overrated or not as good as other places.
quotes: Best pizza is the real deal there is no doubt about it.
Overrated. It was ok, but there it's better pizza in Williamsburg for certain.

themes.label: White slice
themes.text: The white slice with caramelized onions is repeatedly recommended and called one of the best white slices in Brooklyn or the city.
quotes: Best's White Pizza might actually be the best White slice in Brooklyn!
Get the white slice with carmelized onions.

themes.label: Price and value
themes.text: Some find it overpriced for Williamsburg, while others say it is affordable or worth the price.
quotes: Pizza is okay, it is way too overpriced
This ain't dollar pizza, but it's worth it.

themes.label: Grandma slice and meatballs
themes.text: Reviewers praise the grandma slice, pepperoni slice and meatballs as favorites.
quotes: Always a great slice. Grandma slice. My favorite here.
Pizza is delicious, love the grandma slice. Meatballs are legit as well

themes.label: Atmosphere, music and service
themes.text: Reviewers like the friendly staff, music, art and laid-back vibe, and some mention quick service.
quotes: Chill atmosphere, awesome music, great pizza, fast service. What's not to like?
awesome vibes and artwork inside

themes.label: Food quality and flavor
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the food as delicious, naming dishes such as tajine, zaatar chicken, hummus, lamb and Moroccan eggs.
quotes: Best Tajine I have eaten outside of Morocco! Great atmosphere
the meat is perfectly cooked every time. I don't know how they get their chicken so juicy and tender

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Many describe friendly, attentive or quick service, but others report slow brunch service, ignored tables, order mistakes and a seating policy complaint.
quotes: Very nice ambiance, quick service and tastey food! Well done!
The food is good the wait staff isn't up to par.

themes.label: Atmosphere and decor
themes.text: Reviewers like the cozy, friendly vibe, the decor and the garden seating, though one finds it really loud and another wants better ambiance.
quotes: The seats in the garden make you feel like beeing in the tropics
The atmosphere is totally cool with a chill vibe.

themes.label: Brunch and breakfast
themes.text: Many call the breakfast and brunch great, especially Moroccan and Israeli eggs, while a few say brunch food is mediocre or poorly cooked.
quotes: The best breakfast in Williamsburg! Amazing Israeli breakfast, and their hummus is the best in town.
Stay away from the brunch, not worth it. My eggs were full of water and half cooked.

themes.label: Waits and crowding
themes.text: Reviewers say the place fills up fast, so they advise booking ahead and expect waits, particularly at weekends.

we had the best oysters we have ever had here. They were each so unique and with very distinct flavors.

themes.label: Cocktails and absinthe
themes.text: Cocktails, especially the absinthe-based menu, are repeatedly described as excellent, well made and among the best reviewers have had.
quotes: The drinks aren't cheap but they are well made and delicious. They use fresh ingredients a lot, have a fun absinthe menu
Some of the very best absinthe cocktails in the 5 Burroughs.

themes.label: Atmosphere and decor
themes.text: Many reviewers love the old-fashioned, cozy, 1920s or New Orleans-style ambiance and the beautiful interior.
quotes: Great 1920s atmosphere, dining experience.
Super awesome vibe. Love stepping back in time when I come here.

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Most reviewers praise knowledgeable, attentive servers, but a few describe slow service, rude staff or being upsold.
quotes: Servers cater selection to preference of the customer, and are very knowledgeable about what they are selling!
Rude staff that made us feel unwelcome.

themes.label: Prices and portions
themes.text: Some find it pricey with small dishes, while others value the happy hour oyster deals.
quotes: be ready to pay $30 for a small lobster roll.
Oyster happy hour is amazing, prices almost as good as buying straight from the fish market

themes.label: Food quality and flavor
themes.text: Most reviewers call the food delicious and inventive, singling out dishes like ceviche, quinoa salad, lomo saltado and tiradito.
quotes: Quinoa appetizer and cheviche are amazing. The roast chicken is great to share.
We loved the quinoa salad, corn cake with cheese and the salmon tiradito. The lomo saltado is amazing!!!

themes.label: Small portions, high prices
themes.text: Many reviewers found portions small and prices high, though a few felt the dishes were worth the cost.
quotes: $ 18 for a tiny portion of ceviche? $23 for a small seafood rice? I'm sorry but not worth it.
The food is great, but the servings are small so expect to spend more than you imagine at first.

themes.label: Service
themes.text: Many praise friendly, attentive staff and bartenders, while others report rude management, declining quality, an over-attentive waiter, or an unconcerned hostess.
quotes: Delicious food, fantastic service, comfortable ambience
You'll have to wait even if you have a reservation and the hostess won't care.

themes.label: Atmosphere and decor
themes.text: Reviewers like the modern decor, vibe, music and rooftop, though a few note it is dark and noisy when full.
quotes: Great cocktails and beautiful design. Love the music and all the plush greenery hanging from the ceiling.
Interior is beautiful but too dark to read menus.

themes.label: Not traditional Peruvian
themes.text: Some Peruvian reviewers found the food too reinterpreted or pretentious, while others valued its creative, fusion take on Peruvian cuisine.
quotes: this place plays too much with the traditional peruvian food. If you are looking to enjoy regular dishes , this is not the place for you.
the chef has created his own concept using Peruvian flavors and ingredients.

themes.label: Japanese breakfast
themes.text: Reviewers praise the traditional Japanese breakfast, with fish, rice and egg, as carefully prepared, authentic and among the best they have had.
quotes: The most authentic Japanese breakfast experience I've had in the states. Every individual element is prepared perfectly
BEST. BREAKFAST. OF MY LIFE.

themes.label: Long waits
themes.text: Many report waits from 25 minutes to two hours, mostly judged worth it, though some found them frustrating and others were seated quickly.
quotes: The wait is freakishly long but worth the wait.
Went on a very cold day, there was no wait for two.

themes.label: Ramen and mazemen
themes.text: Seafood-based ramen and mazemen, especially the tuna and uni versions, are repeatedly called delicious and flavorful, though one found the uni mazemen so-so.
quotes: the (seafood) mazemen is unique and phenomenal.
The Spicy Tuna Mazemen is to die for!

themes.label: Small cozy space
themes.text: The restaurant is tiny with few seats, but reviewers describe a cozy, friendly atmosphere and kind, attentive staff.
quotes: Very small but super cozy place with high level meals
Such an enjoyable experience in such a small space.

themes.label: Price and tipping
themes.text: Some find prices reasonable and like tips being included, while others say portions are small, the cost high or an extra charge excessive.
quotes: price is very reasonable, I especially love the concept of including the tips in the bill.
the portions were still too small for that certain price

themes.label: Meal taste and flavor
themes.text: Most reviewers describe the meals as delicious, flavorful and home-cooked tasting, though a few say quality or variety slipped.
quotes: All of the meals have been great. Fresh, and very tasty. I haven't had one that I didn't enjoy!!
I was surprised that the food was very good and tasty

themes.label: Customer service help
themes.text: Reviewers praise quick, friendly support staff who fixed order problems, though one found service unhelpful and another had to fight for a fix.
quotes: The staff has been quick to respond and extremely helpful.
they were very unhelpful and actually spoke to me like I was the one who did something wrong

themes.label: Convenience and quick prep
themes.text: Reviewers value that meals save cooking time, heat in about three minutes, and fit busy schedules.
quotes: Chef quality meals that only take 3 mins in the microwave. Can't beat it.
I love the food and it saves me so much time with my busy schedule.

themes.label: Delivery reliability
themes.text: Many report on-time, fresh deliveries, but two early reviewers say orders never arrived.
quotes: Food got delivered fast and fresh!!
I was notified the food was delivered. It is not here.

themes.label: Price and value
themes.text: Many call the price fair or reasonable, while some find it a bit costly or pricey at about $10 per meal.
quotes: Great food. A little costly at $10.00 per meal.
The cost is more than reasonable

themes.label: Fresh, tasty seafood
themes.text: Many reviewers praise the fresh seafood and fried fish, shrimp and crab legs, and say they have returned for years.
quotes: As always, the freshest seafood and best pina coladas in New York City.
Great fried fish of all kinds, the best tartar sauce, wonderful melting pot of diners from around the Bronx and around the world.

themes.label: Crowds on weekends
themes.text: Reviewers say the restaurant gets very crowded, especially on weekends, warm days and holidays, and advise going on weekdays.
quotes: Try to go on weekdays cause its always packed on the weekend.
Good food, great atmosphere, bit pricey and can be very crowded

themes.label: Waterfront view and setting
themes.text: The waterside location, ocean view and outdoor seating are liked, though some mention aggressive birds.
quotes: Very, very nice. Right on the water. Friendly staff and their seafood is GREAT!!
Fresh seafood, ice cold beer and great views

themes.label: Seasoning and flavor
themes.text: Several reviewers found the food bland or under-seasoned, with some also finding the fries soggy or items burnt.
quotes: Food wasn't that good. Was missing some saesoning. They use to be better than that
Drinks are 100% great , but i just wish they will season there food.

themes.label: Cleanliness of the place
themes.text: Some reviewers say the restaurant is dirty or needs faster cleaning, and that tables are left messy.
quotes: Their alcohol drinks are pretty good but the place is just a bit to dirty
Great food, if it was a little cleaner they will get the 5 stars.

themes.label: Friendly, attentive staff
themes.text: Many reviewers praise the staff, service and owners as friendly, welcoming and attentive, though a couple of reviewers found service subpar.
quotes: Very friendly and welcoming staff.

themes.label: Cocktails and bar
themes.text: Cocktails, the bar and drink selection are widely praised, including the tequila sundae and cheap takeout drinks, though one reviewer found the cocktails weak.
quotes: Best tequila cocktail I've ever had - tequila sundae
They just started margaritas and cocktails for takeout and they are cheap and delicious

themes.label: Food quality and dishes
themes.text: Most reviewers call the food delicious, naming duck confit, varenyky and steak au poivre, but two found dishes mediocre or underwhelming.
quotes: Varenyky are delicious and so was borsch.
the food is mediocre at best

themes.label: Interior and atmosphere
themes.text: Reviewers like the beautiful, clean, elegant decor and relaxed, lively vibe, even the one who disliked the food and service.
quotes: Delicious food in a beautiful interior.
Place was pretty lively, music was nice, you could actually have a conversation.

themes.label: Reasonable prices
themes.text: Reviewers describe wine, drinks and meals as reasonably priced or cheap, including during takeout.
quotes: Wine very reasonably priced for NYC.

themes.label: Large portions, good value
themes.text: Many reviewers say portions are big, with leftovers or leaving full, and often feel this makes the high prices worthwhile.
quotes: I thought it was a bit pricey until I saw the portions they give you. It's well worth the money.
A little pricey, but you get a lot of food.

themes.label: Prices too high
themes.text: Several reviewers call the restaurant pricey or overpriced, with some saying the food does not justify the cost.
quotes: Good but not 50 dollars minimum a plate good.
If I'm paying $40 and better for a meal (and that's just fish or shrimp), it should be flawless.

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Most reviewers praise friendly, fast service, but a few report bad service, arguing staff or poor crowd control at the front desk.

themes.label: Food quality and freshness
themes.text: Many call the seafood delicious and fresh, while others found it stale, unseasoned, overcooked or not what it used to be.
quotes: Great place for fresh fish. Hands down the best I would say in USA!
Dinner was OK. Food not what it used to be.

themes.label: Crowding and waits

themes.label: Drinks and cocktails

The cocktails are excellent and the food is great.

themes.label: Crowds and long waits

The food is ok just a long wait

themes.label: Prices and portions
themes.text: Some find prices decent and portions large, while others say the food became overpriced with small portions.
quotes: There snow crab legs are great and they give you a big portion
Food is too expensive and portions are small.

themes.label: Seafood dishes quality
themes.text: Most praise dishes like crab legs, lobster tails and fried fish, but others call the food mediocre, flavorless or worse than before.

The fish doesn't have any flavor.

themes.label: Outdoor seating and view

eating outside next to the water

themes.label: Hot dog quality

Cheap and cheerful and you have to go to this Coney Island institution but the hotdogs are way too salty

themes.label: Service and staff attitude

The rudest staff I've ever met.

themes.label: Waits and long lines

Many registers so if you encounter a line no need to panic as you'll get through quickly.

themes.label: Price for value

A little pricey but it's Nathan's. At Coney Island.

fries were overly cooked you can taste nothjng by the old.oil they cooked it in.

themes.label: Crowds and long lines

Almost two hours on line and then we go In make our order

themes.label: Water views and atmosphere
themes.text: Reviewers praise the waterfront view, the relaxed vibe and the indoor and outdoor seating.
quotes: Great place to take in the beautiful views of the Throggs Neck Bridge and water.
Some best freshest seafood and incredible view

themes.label: Shrimp and fried seafood
themes.text: Many love the shrimp and fried seafood, while others found it flavorless, dry, or with breading falling off.
quotes: Love their shrimp! Been coming here for years, even before renovation.
The breading was falling off the shrimp and the fries were soggy.

themes.label: Cash only payment
themes.text: Several reviewers point out the restaurant takes only cash, with an ATM on site, and some wish this would change.
quotes: Oh and this is still a CASH ONLY place (wish they would change that).
Minus one star because it's cash only, although there is an ATM on site.

themes.label: Prices and portions
themes.text: Some find good prices and portions, especially at the raw bar, while others call it overpriced or say portions are too small.
quotes: Not enough food for your money.
Good food, great portion for the money.

themes.label: Sicilian square pizza
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the square Sicilian pizza, with its sauce on top and fluffy dough, as the best in Brooklyn, though a few found it undercooked or merely fine.

The square pie was tasty, but undercooked, very doughy...making it feel like it just sits at the bottom of your stomach.

themes.label: Spumoni dessert
themes.text: Reviewers regularly call the spumoni excellent and a must-try dessert, often the best they have had.
quotes: it was my first time trying spumoni. I'm officially hooked. Definitely worth the wait.
The spumoni next door is excellent as well.

themes.label: Crowds and parking
themes.text: Reviewers say the place gets packed and parking can be hard, though some note multiple windows, plenty of seating and a free lot.

Recommended place but be aware that it's almost always packed

themes.label: Service
themes.text: Most describe service as fast, nice or improving, while one reviewer said the waiter forgot the order and another called it just okay.

Waiter just forgetting what you ordered but after you recall him he remember.

themes.label: Prices and value
themes.text: Some find it fairly priced with big portions and good value, while others say prices have risen and it is expensive.
quotes: Prices are really getting out of hand, $9.75 for a meatball (3 meatballs) parm hero.
Great value for pie and quickest slice in the boro

themes.label: Friendly, helpful staff
themes.text: Most reviewers praise friendly, attentive staff and good customer service, though a few describe rude, annoyed or dishonest employees.
quotes: Staff was very sweet and thankful for the frontline.
Staff needs to be more friendly, they seemed upset and annoyed

themes.label: Fresh, tasty donuts
themes.text: Many reviewers say the donuts are fresh, delicious and melt in the mouth, with the glazed ones singled out.
quotes: Fresh baked Glazed Doughnuts are like heaven in your mouth!
Donuts were very fresh and tasty.

themes.label: Slow lines and waits
themes.text: Reviewers report long waits, with online orders no faster than walk-ins, though some find the line short or worth it.

it was only 7 of us in line and i had to wait for 45 minutes

themes.label: Cleanliness of the store
themes.text: Reviewers describe the store as clean and neat, and some note good social distancing.

The store was clean and shiny.

themes.label: Online and delivery order problems

quotes: Order for delivery my order never arrived I called to they told me my order left the store at 6:12
YOU CAN NOT CANCEL YOUR ORDER ONLINE. THERE IS NO OPTION FOR THAT.

themes.label: Long waits and lines
themes.text: Many reviewers describe long, slow lines, especially on weekends, but most say the food is worth the wait; a few call the service slow or disorganized.
quotes: Spent one hour plus on the line to get food today, Sunday, September 2nd.
Long lines but the food was worth the wait.

themes.label: Doubles quality
themes.text: Doubles are repeatedly called the best, with praise for the sauces and chutney, though one reviewer says they are no longer as good as before.
quotes: The best doubles I've tasted in a long time their cucumber chutney is wow
The only disappointment is that the doubles is no longer good like it was a few years ago.

themes.label: Staff friendliness and service

quotes: They behave as though they are doing you a favor and not that you are paying your money.
The staff is friendly and helpful and the shop itself is very clean.

themes.label: Authentic Trinidadian food

Love this place best Trini Food in New York worth the drive from Long Island .

themes.label: Cleanliness and seating

quotes: Clean establishment well lit with delicious food prepared fresh while you wait.
there aren't many available seats in the evening on weekends, we usually just take it home.

themes.label: Birria tacos quality

quotes: Tacos have an outer crispy layer and a soft layer. Meat is well seasoned and tender.
the meat is really tender and the consome really brings the dish together.

themes.label: Consomé broth
themes.text: The consomé is praised as flavorful and a must-get for dipping tacos, with some saying it rivals the tacos.
quotes: You gotta get the consume and dip the tacos in that lovely broth. Magic right there.
Consome arguably better than taco, but that's splitting hairs.

themes.label: Long lines, worth waiting

The only bad thing about this taco spot is that there's always a wait

themes.label: Low prices, good value

quotes: Between my husband , child & I we spend 35$ for 9 tacos 1 soup & 2 sodas .

The guy aggressively said "no, and to move on with the order".

themes.label: Retro 60s design
themes.text: Reviewers love the preserved mid-century terminal, the retro decor and the nostalgic feel of stepping back in time.
quotes: OMG, a perfect restoration to teleport you back to the 60's
Spectacular design, mind-blowing attention to detail, a master-class in branding.

themes.label: Staff and service
themes.text: Some guests praise friendly, helpful staff, while others report rude or untrained front desk staff and impersonal kiosk check-in.
quotes: Extremely rude front staff.....need to step up your game!! What about some customer service!
First class customer service!

themes.label: Rooms and beds
themes.text: Rooms are often called quiet and comfortable with good beds, but some find them small, dirty or lacking amenities.
quotes: The room had a very comfortable bed and it was quite.
got to our room to discover an unflushed toilet and a dirty washcloth in the shower.

themes.label: Food and drink prices
themes.text: Several reviewers find food and drinks pricey, though some praise the food quality and cocktails.
quotes: Cool trip back in time except for the 5 dollar cup of coffee
Food is a little pricey, but that's to be expected.

themes.label: Rooftop pool and bars
themes.text: Guests enjoy the rooftop pool and bar views and the cocktails in the Constellation plane lounge.
quotes: Great, unique view; and much less expensive than other rooftops around the city
heated rooftop pool was still open and worthy of a dip even when it's 35f outside

themes.label: Pizza taste and quality
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the pizza as delicious, with a crisp NY-style crust and fresh toppings, though a few found it bland, burnt or not good.
quotes: Great crispy thin crust pizza, as good as NYC pizza is, Ive had some bad pizza experiences, but this place was great
Foldable crust with the edge crisp that has to snap to fold. It was perfect.

themes.label: Friendly staff and service
themes.text: Many reviewers describe friendly, attentive staff and a kind owner, with excellent service, though one reviewer found the staff disrespectful.
quotes: The pizza was delicious and the staff is very friendly!
Disrespectful staff.hes mad at the world.Not worth a visit

themes.label: Cheap slice deals
themes.text: Reviewers like the low prices, especially the two slices and a soda for about five dollars deal.
quotes: 2 regular slices and a soda for 5 bucks can't be beat.
They have an offer of 2 pieces of pizza plus a soda ($ 5).

themes.label: Tiny space
themes.text: The shop is described as very small with few seats, suiting takeaway or a quick slice; one reviewer disliked this, another found it homey.
quotes: It's a small place though more suitable for takeaways
There are only 4 or so chairs.

themes.label: Food quality
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the food, naming fish tacos, fries, burgers, sliders and sprouts, though a few found dishes flavorless, undercooked or disappointing.
quotes: Amazing fries with truffe and parmesan!
We liked our drinks but the food was terrible. Flavorless and not fully cooked.

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Staff and bartenders are mostly described as friendly and attentive, but some reviews report slow, unfriendly or absent service.
quotes: Amazing ambience and super attentive service.
Service was very slow and unfriendly.

themes.label: Drinks and beer
themes.text: Reviewers generally enjoy the drinks, cocktails and beer selection, though a couple found the drinks standard, watered down or a mix unavailable.
quotes: Drinks were also phenomenal, great sangria and hibiscus lemonade.
The drinks werr watered down and awful.

themes.label: Atmosphere and seating
themes.text: The cozy decor, upstairs area and outdoor seating are liked, with one reviewer finding the bar music too loud.
quotes: Great vibe! I adore the upstairs seating area
Music at the bar is too loud.

themes.label: Prices and happy hour
themes.text: Reviewers mostly describe prices, happy hour deals and portions as good or reasonable, with one calling the beer overpriced.
quotes: Happy hour rates are good.. the appetizers were good and cheap too
Nope just standard stuff and overpriced.

themes.label: Ice cream cakes
themes.text: Reviewers praise the ice cream cakes, including as grab-and-go or delivered options, a fast customized order, and one calling it the best.
quotes: Still the best ice cream cake on planet earth.
The service was fast even with a customized cake.

themes.label: Staff and service
themes.text: Most reviewers describe friendly, attentive staff, though others report slow service, a short-changed customer, and confusing instructions from an employee.
quotes: The staff their is awesome and attentive. They let my try every flavor due to my indecisiveness.
service was a little slow today but usually on point.

themes.label: Prices and value
themes.text: Several reviewers like the discounted milkshakes and good prices, but one found the small cup expensive for tiny scoops.
quotes: Always consistent and they always have good prices.
The scoops are very small compared to reval like baskin robbins.

themes.label: Ice cream and shakes quality
themes.text: Most reviewers enjoy the soft serve, ice cream and shakes, but one said the ice cream tasted stale and not smooth.
quotes: Ice creams & shakes are yummy .
To make it morse the ice cream taste stale. It's definitely not smooth or fresh.

themes.label: Quick lunch service
themes.text: Many reviewers describe it as a fast, efficient spot for a quick lunch or takeaway, though it gets busy at lunchtime.
quotes: Decent place for lunch. Fast, efficient, and reliable.
Great little Japanese takeaway spot, fast and super tasty

themes.label: Price and value
themes.text: Most reviewers call prices cheap or reasonable, but several 2019-2020 reviews find it overpriced for the quality of the food.
quotes: Pretty good food cheap prices for Manhattan
Way too overpriced for the quality of food.

themes.label: Sushi quality and discounts
themes.text: Sushi is often called good or fresh, with a popular discount after 3pm, but some find it ordinary or poorly made.
quotes: Very good sushi. Mon. To fri. 3-6 pm enjoy 30% discounts, super cool.
If you want ok quality of sushi that is served very quickly this is the spot.

themes.label: Hot dishes and bowls
themes.text: Katsu, don bowls and bento boxes get praise, while ramen, udon and some hot dishes are criticized as overcooked, bland or too sweet.
quotes: The Don dishes are really good ! I usually get the chiken teridon
The beef was way over cooked and the noodles literally taste like instant ramen.

themes.label: Upstairs seating and cleanliness
themes.text: Reviewers appreciate the clean shop and the spacious second-floor seating area for eating in.
quotes: They have a spacious well lit, and clean second floor to sit and dine.

themes.label: Slow service and waits
themes.text: Many reviewers describe long waits for drinks and food, including mobile orders that were not ready, and disorganized staff, though a few say service was quick.
quotes: The two servers in the afternoon were so slow it was actually faster to walk over to Nassau to get my drink.
I ordered online and I still had to wait another 10 minutes when my order was "ready".

themes.label: Staff attitude and friendliness
themes.text: Some reviewers praise friendly, helpful baristas who know their orders, while others report rude, unprofessional or inattentive staff.
quotes: The girls are all so eager to help. They make my mornings better.
The people who work there are slow and rude.

themes.label: Small, crowded store
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly describe the store as tiny, cramped and crowded, with little or no seating.
quotes: One of the smallest Starbucks I have ever seen.
No seating and difficult to actually get in.

themes.label: Wrong or missed orders
themes.text: Several reviewers say their orders were made wrong, forgotten, or missing ingredients.
quotes: 3/4 times I've been there they got my order wrong...
2 times out of my 4 visits in June, they forgot to make my drink order.

themes.label: Vegan food quality
themes.text: Reviewers praise tasty, flavorful vegan dishes with a wide menu, often saying meat eaters would enjoy them too, though a few found food disappointing.
quotes: incredibly good vegan asian cuisine. well prepared and well spiced.
Delicious vegan options, good enough even to please meat eaters.

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Some found service excellent and quick, while others described it as slow, hands off, apathetic or rude.
quotes: Only complain is how slow the service is. Seemed like there was only one person working as the server and counterperson.
Service was not good, it felt like an apathetic robot was serving us.

themes.label: Fast delivery
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly highlight quick delivery and good takeout.
quotes: Love this place! Food is good and delivery is SO FAST

themes.label: Ambiance and decor
themes.text: Diners describe a beautiful, quiet, relaxing and well-decorated room, though one noted a loud group nearby.
quotes: Quiet, relaxing atmosphere, delicious vegan dishes, excellent service.
I was very impressed with the ambiance of the place as well as the service and food.

themes.label: Price and portions
themes.text: Some call prices excellent and cheap with big portions, while others find it overpriced with small portions.
quotes: it's overpriced and portions are pretty small.
Nice food and excellent prices.

themes.label: Burgers
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly call the burgers among the best in the area, juicy and cooked to the requested medium rare.
quotes: Best Burgers! Bacon melts in your mouth. Perfectly MR .
I appreciate that when I ordered it medium rare it actually came out medium rare

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Most reviewers describe friendly, attentive, fast staff, but a few report a rude waiter and unexpected automatic gratuity or extra tip charges.
quotes: The staff are very welcoming, friendly & professional.
he added 20% gratuity automatically for our party of two. He didn't ask and he didn't even point it out.

themes.label: Cozy atmosphere
themes.text: Many describe the room as cozy, warm and welcoming, though one reviewer found the decor unimpressive and another found the space small.
quotes: The atmosphere is warm & cozy.
But the decor won't impress a date.

themes.label: Milkshakes
themes.text: Reviewers praise the milkshakes, including the chocolate malt and the adult versions.
quotes: Best milkshakes hands down.
Regular and adult milkshakes too!

themes.label: Wings and sides
themes.text: Wings, fries and onion rings get praise, with fries described as crisp and the wings called among the best in Brooklyn.
quotes: CHICKEN WINGS ARE THE BEST IN WILLIAMSBURG!
these were light, crisp and fantastic

themes.label: Vegan and vegetarian options
themes.text: Many reviewers praise the extensive vegan, vegetarian and gluten-free choices, including convincing vegan cheese, and say the food suits mixed groups of eaters.
quotes: Went with 2 vegans, 1 vegetarian and 2 omnivores and this place had something for everyone.
I'm vegan and the first time I felt like I was eating food made as it's supposed to be

themes.label: Wine selection
themes.text: Reviewers frequently praise the natural wines on tap, flights and knowledgeable bar staff, though one reviewer found the tap wines not good.
quotes: you can do a flight and try 4 different ones!
The bartenders were all very knowledgeable about the wine that they served

themes.label: Cozy romantic atmosphere
themes.text: The small, rustic, dimly lit room is described as cozy, charming and romantic, good for dates, though seating is limited.
quotes: Venue is rustic and cozy.
Ambiance was low lit and rustic.

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Most reviewers found staff friendly and attentive, but others reported slow service, an overburdened waiter, or unhelpful staff.
quotes: the staff were super friendly, they took particular care in looking after my fiancé who is celiac
There was one waiter for the whole place, who was overburdened.

themes.label: Pizza
themes.text: Pizza, especially the vegan and fried-dough versions, is widely praised, though one reviewer called it overpriced and poor.
quotes: I was genuinely surprised at how good their vegan pizza was (I'm not vegan).
The pizza was like something you'd get at a rest stop

themes.label: Food quality and flavor
themes.text: Most reviewers call the vegan food delicious and flavorful, praising the seitan, mushroom burger and desserts, though a few found it mediocre or had specific complaints.
quotes: The vegan cheese on the mushroom burger was better than most real cheeses I've had and now I'm on the hunt to find where I can buy it myself.
Food is mediocre, needs a lot of flavor/ texture improvement. Buffalo cauliflower was the only good thing we had

themes.label: Staff friendliness and service
themes.text: Staff are mostly described as friendly, attentive and helpful, including with allergies, but a few reviewers reported slow service, a missing menu and forgotten items.
quotes: The waitress was well trained on identifying nut-free options for us. And the manager visited our table multiple times to answer any questions about how the food is prepared.
15 minutes without a menu and it was not even packed at full capacity.

themes.label: Price and value
themes.text: Some find it pricey for the quality, while others call prices reasonable or the portions and value great.
quotes: Amazing portions and choices. Great value for money. Best seitan I've ever had!
Not terrible food but I would expect to pay a lot less.

themes.label: Cramped seating and furniture
themes.text: Reviewers mention tight, crowded space, uncomfortable chairs and tiny bathrooms, and tables that clash with the decor.
quotes: Cons: cramped tables, uncomfortable chairs, inaccessible and tiny bathrooms

themes.label: Portion sizes
themes.text: Several reviewers found portions generous, while others described the amount of food as moderate.
quotes: the portions are generous and you won't leave hungry
The amount of food is moderate and very delicious.

themes.label: Dosa quality and taste
themes.text: Most reviewers call the dosas delicious and amazing, but a few found them average or worse than other South Indian options, especially Indian visitors.
quotes: We stood in the line for about 2 hours to have a less than average dosa.
Amazing vegan meal with the right amount of heat and love.

themes.label: Friendly, kind owner
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly praise Thiru as kind, friendly, generous and honest, and say he makes customers' day.
quotes: Just a simple man making amazing dhosa's and making people's day.
Friendly owner. Decent dosa. Good location next to the park and NYU.

themes.label: Long waiting lines
themes.text: Some said the long wait was not worth it, while others felt it was worth waiting or said lines moved fast.
quotes: Not worth the long wait.
Legit worth waiting in line for hours.

themes.label: Cheap price and portion
themes.text: Reviewers describe the food as cheap and good value, though one notes the dosa is travel-sized rather than full size.
quotes: The dosa was definitely filling and cheap.

themes.label: Finding the location
themes.text: The park-side spot is liked, but one reviewer says he is sometimes absent and hard to find, and another had to walk far.
quotes: walked nearly 40mins to find this location at washington park
Good location next to the park and NYU.

themes.label: Friendly, attentive staff
themes.text: Most reviewers praise friendly, welcoming staff and owners, though a few describe snarky or rude servers, slow service, or a petty bartender.
quotes: The staff is always very friendly and remembered my name after only two visits.
The staff was incredibly rude, honestly offensive.

themes.label: Food quality
themes.text: Many reviewers call the food delicious or amazing, though a few found it overcooked, generic or merely average for the price.
quotes: Food was so amazing! The environment was cozy and modern.
Overpriced generic burger, mushy over cooked spaghetti, weird chicken in the Caesar salad

themes.label: Drinks and beer selection
themes.text: Reviewers frequently praise the cocktails, whiskey, wine and beer lists, though one says the beer selection is terrible.
quotes: Amazing selection of whiskeys, great beers on tap, a very friendly staff
Despite their claims the beer selection is terrible.

themes.label: Burger
themes.text: The burger is repeatedly called among the best, with one reviewer finding it a bit small.
quotes: The cheeseburger is the best I've had in my life and the service is outstanding.
Burger seemed kinda small, but was good for what I had.

themes.label: Pop-ups and events
themes.text: Reviewers enjoy the pop-up kitchens, themed nights, parties and monthly events, and one held a wedding reception there.
quotes: Great themed nights and amazing food pop ups!
Their monthly events are a blast– really enjoyed the cheese making class.

themes.label: Delicious authentic Israeli food
themes.text: Reviewers praise the flavorful, authentic Israeli dishes, especially shakshuka, hummus, falafel and jachnun, though a few criticize the burgers, a sandwich and a salad.
quotes: The falafel balls were crunchy, the hummus delicious, the pita getting close to what you get in Israel and the pickles cut through the richness.
Really enjoyed the authentic Israeli cuisine. Shakshuka is a must!

themes.label: Loud music
themes.text: Several reviewers found the music too loud for conversation and said staff would not lower it because management wanted a party atmosphere.
quotes: the music is so loud you just want to leave as fast as possible. A nightmare to stay inside.
on Sunday the music was so loud that we were almost shouting to be able to chat with my friend over brunch.

themes.label: Friendly staff and service
themes.text: Most reviewers describe friendly, attentive staff, but some found service slow, subpar or unorganized, and a few reported order mistakes.
quotes: Staff are very friendly and genuinely attentive. Will be back for sure!
The service was a little slow and unorganized but the servers were all really nice

themes.label: Waits and crowding
themes.text: Reviewers mention long waits, queues and packed rooms, especially at weekend brunch, though some say the food is worth waiting for.
quotes: not the fastest service, but worth the wait.
As per brunch standard be prepared to wait on a Sunday.

themes.label: Fun atmosphere and decor
themes.text: Many reviewers enjoy the lively, cozy, authentic atmosphere, the decor, and the indoor and outdoor seating.
quotes: It feels exactly like stepping into a café in Tel-Aviv. Great food, great service.
Outdoor seating is really nice!

themes.label: Service speed and quality
themes.text: Reviewers disagree: many praise friendly, helpful staff, while others describe very slow service, being ignored, and rude staff.
quotes: Our waitress was helpful and kind and the staff behind the coffee bar was very hospitable; greeted us as we entered and said goodbye as we left.
Counter person was moving like a glacier. Nobody else in sight. Sit at a table and order? Good luck.

themes.label: Bread, pastries and sweets
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly praise the bread, pastries, cookies, waffles and other baked treats as delicious and fresh.
quotes: The bread is great, the pastries are awesome.
Wonderful bakery cafe with so many delicious treats.

themes.label: High prices
themes.text: Several reviewers found the food overpriced for what was served, citing small portions and costly soups, waffles and sandwiches.
quotes: they charged $20 for 2 soups which probably had $1 worth of ingredients.
at $7.99 I expected more than one small waffle.

themes.label: Healthy fresh food
themes.text: Reviewers like the fresh, healthy, organic and vegetarian options, with avocado toast mentioned several times.
quotes: Food is really fresh and healthy. I like avocado toast and quinoa salad!
Friendly staff, good food, many healthy choices and many options for vegetarians

themes.label: Ambience and setting
themes.text: Reviewers describe a relaxing, French-style room and outdoor seating, though one found the room too hot.
quotes: The establishment is right out of a country kitchen in France.
This location is nice as it has a large outdoors area.
